prompt: Four players are each assigned a different crystal to destroy at the same moment.
tells: each assigned a different crystal to destroy at the same moment
why: Assigned jobs and shared timing are coordination.
trap: Everyone has a different job, not the same reaction.

prompt: The boss stacks a debuff on the tank, so two tanks must swap on a set count.
tells: two tanks must swap on a set count
why: Taking turns by plan is coordination.
trap: It isn't about noticing; it's about the agreed handoff.

prompt: Specific players must take turns controlling enemies so the tank stays alive.
trap: Each player's attention matters, but the plan is the test.

prompt: Groups of three must take turns soaking a recurring beam, and the next group must be ready.
tells: take turns soaking a recurring beam
trap: Where to stand is known; who goes when is the test.

prompt: A raid leader calls 'left team, right team' every phase, and the fight fails if teams act out of sync.
tells: fails if teams act out of sync
why: Group timing on calls is coordination.
trap: Positions are set; timing between teams is the test.

prompt: Three players agree an interrupt order: first, second, third, then repeat.
why: A planned order across players is coordination.
trap: A single interrupt would be attention; an order is coordination.
